experience.title: Work Experience
descriptions: From June 2013 to September 2018, at Time Intermedia Inc., I was involved in the development and operation of various systems including core systems, VOD web services, qualification management systems, and e-commerce services. I experienced growth from a development member to a development leader, also taking on team member training and PM support roles.

Since October 2018 at Studist Corporation, I have been working as an SRE and Product Tech Lead on service launches, operations, maintenance, development support, construction, and availability/performance improvements. From March 2023, I took on the role of Product Tech Lead, making technical decisions and realizing roadmaps. Starting from March 2025, I will serve as the final decision maker for all technical matters across the company, overseeing technical strategy, architecture, and engineering practices. Since September 2025, I have served as VP of Technology.

Since January 2019, while working as a company employee, I have been providing development and operational support to other companies as a sole proprietor, and from April 2024, I have also been active as the CEO of Labee LLC.

projects.detailDescription: Chimr is a macOS application designed to help users never miss important meetings. It provides prominent fullscreen notifications for upcoming meetings across various calendar platforms (iCloud, Google, Outlook, Exchange) with one-click meeting join functionality. The app supports MCP (Model Context Protocol), allowing integration with MCP clients like Claude Desktop. Currently in beta for macOS 14.0 (Sonoma) and later.

projects.title: sallyport
projects.description: A trust-based, per-directory shell hook for zsh and bash.
projects.detailDescription: Applies environment variables declared in a .sallyport.jsonc file the moment you cd into the directory that owns it, like direnv, but every config must be explicitly trusted before it's ever applied. Trust is a hash of the config's identity and content, so an edit after review silently revokes it. Also verifies the trust store itself is owned by you and not writable by anyone else.

projects.title: nooon

projects.detailDescription: A Notion MCP server built for AI coding agents like Claude Code. Uses the TOON format to minimize output size, caches based on last_edited_time, and fetches nested blocks recursively in a single call. Read-only by design.

projects.detailDescription: Lists, filters, and inspects translation keys, detects untranslated and stale entries, and supports CSV import/export for spreadsheet-based translation workflows. Ships as a single Go binary, so it runs headless on Linux CI without Xcode.
